name: Czechia
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national level across key layers (Poslanecká sněmovna, European Parliament roll calls, parties SOCDEM and Zelení, trade union confederation ČMKOS, academic economists, and wealth managers), the 14 kraje (NUTS 3) and 6,258 obce (LAU). First pass R001 (2026-10-31).

polls.question: Introduction of a tax on super-wealth (assets above 111 million CZK at a rate of 3.5%)
polls.question_original: Zavedení daně ze superbohatství (tedy majetku nad 111 milionů korun sazbou 3,5 %)
